summary: Test-writing phase for issue #39. Authored and committed the solver parity corpus test (fixture + corpus-driven assertions incl. ties, exclusions, weight handling, solver 1x1 cross-check) and the /api/v1 wire-contract tests guarding the generated-OpenAPI-client migration, plus corpus documentation under docs/. Runtime execution was not possible in this container: no Swift toolchain is installed, so `swift test` and the pre-commit build/test gate (bin/lint) self-skip by design (lint exit 0, 'verify changes on a host with Swift installed'). The corpus fixture was independently cross-verified against the documented WeightedSquaredError formula with a separate Python implementation: all 11 cases' selections, exclusions, bit-exact tie groups, and expected errors (anchor 0.205) match. swift test must be run on a Swift host / CI before merge; statuses below reflect that pending runtime verification.
